summary: Shoshone County, ID: a 40-foot pole L-4 lookout built in 1931 that burned the same year and was never replaced; only cement footings are described today.

facts.status_note: Burned in 1931 and never replaced; the Idaho Fire Lookouts page describes only cement footings left

notes_for_editor: The two pages disagree on elevation (5,425 ft on firelookout.com, 5,238 ft on Idaho Fire Lookouts); the story says so and the record's elevation is left alone. The 40-foot figure is the pole height as stated; the sources do not say whether it is the cab-floor height, so no height_m is given. No source states whether the site is open to the public; the story says so. Idaho Fire Lookouts says no staffing history is documented; firelookout.com does not mention staffing, so staffing is omitted. The McPherson fire is cited from one photo caption only as regional context. No FFLOS or NHLR register page for this site was in the local cache, and the record lists none.
